## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any relevant trade-offs.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`).
- [ ] Python lint and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.

For model/backend changes, describe the device, input duration, and inference checks performed. Distinguish synthetic tests from real model inference.
